crossRefs.note: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
There is one gone out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Remaliah
people.line: Father of Pekah, king of Israel

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
translations.bsb: For Aram, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted your ruin, saying:
translations.kjv: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
translations.asv: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have purposed evil against thee, saying,
